scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ade/shared build && pnpm --filter @ade/runner build && pnpm --filter @ade/web build && pnpm --filter @ade/hub build
scripts.accept:p0: pnpm build && tsx scripts/verify/p0-events-append-only.ts && playwright test e2e/p0-smoke.spec.ts
scripts.accept:p1: pnpm build && tsx scripts/verify/replay-events.ts && tsx scripts/verify/mention-events.ts && playwright test e2e/p1-chat.spec.ts e2e/p1-mention.spec.ts e2e/p1-config-error.spec.ts
scripts.accept:all: pnpm test && pnpm accept:p0 && pnpm accept:p1
